provenance_checks: Compare source page17..72 raw glyphs and separator order with site LP2-00..55, reporting rune parity and punctuation differences separately; do not silently normalize punctuation.
Check MISSING_PRIMES_2013 equals the archived telnet missing interval 73..1223, not CicadaOS prime_echo.
Seek a primary independently pinned witness for CUNEIFORM_STREAM two-character base60 values; absent a match, call it a source-defined key rather than a verified original clue.

trigger.word_rule: source ProcessedText.get_words(): maximal runs of indices<29, every other index separates
trigger.prime_rule: exact source GP primes for each rune index
trigger.direct_hit: sum is in source missing-prime set and (word length>1 or sum>120)
trigger.complement_hit: 3301−sum is in source missing-prime set, no length filter
trigger.launch_rule: at least 3 consecutive hit words within the same source page; reset after any miss; only unsolved pages launch decoders

controls.trigger_positive: Synthetic three words with source GP-prime sums 73,79,83, separated by source hyphen token; must launch exactly once on a synthetic unsolved page.
controls.trigger_negative: Insert an ordinary nonhit word between the second and third marked words; must not launch.
controls.key_positive: Encrypt one documented solved reading with each exact source-derived repeating key and fixed Atbash overlay; original source decode must recover it. Record source unigram fitness and whether its >0.91 screen passes.
controls.route_positive: Invert each source column/diagonal/spiral route at at least two source widths with a documented solved reading; source route plus Atbash overlay must recover it. Record >0.90 screen.
controls.gate_calibration: Compare source solved-reading fitness, planted outputs, and matched within-page shuffled full route/key maxima; no negative manuscript claim if gate misses planted readings or often accepts nulls.

target_execution_policy: Do not score LP2 targets until source punctuation parity, key constants, trigger positives/negative, decoder and route plants, and fitness calibration are reported and reviewed. If source cuneiform has no primary witness, test only as a source-defined stream and state provenance limit. Do not treat repeated source-loop triggers as independent method attempts.
